description: Pipeline configuration for the Fredo agentic state machine. Single source of truth for phases, transitions, labels, and issue types. Loaded by .opencode/scripts/pipeline-state.rs. Contract: docs/agentic-pipeline/state-machine.md.

intake.label: triage
intake.exit_guard: Backlog issue exists with the 8 required intake sections (Title, Problem / Why now, Intended users, Proposed behavior / Scope, Success metrics, Acceptance criteria, Out of scope, Priority), label `triage`

triage.label: triage-plan
triage.exit_guard: The implementation plan deliverable exists and is converged (`.opencode/tmp/<issue>/triage.md` carries all required sections + `## Convergence: agreed`) — the plan, not a GitHub Decision comment, is the triage artifact

implementation.label: ready-for-dev
implementation.exit_guard: Spec integration branch `spec/<N>` has commits beyond main (the developer pushed)

testing.label: testing
testing.exit_guard: Tester verdict (## Tests Runs / ## Evidence, PASS) with live evidence per the plan's Verification policy (a `telemetry_spans` reference for live-policy plans; `> Verification policy: static` drops the live requirement)

audit.label: audit
audit.exit_guard: Self-Improver verdict posted: success, or restart phase + improvement

done.label: done
done.exit_guard: Feature closed, branches cleaned, human review initiated
